supportPolicy: Sandbox development baseline ahead of production. The user approved upgrading the shared sandbox to 0.2.1-rc.1 on 2026-10-17; production stays 0.2.0-rc.2 and product peer declarations stay 0.2.0-rc.2 until the user explicitly selects a new support baseline.

sourceProvenance.method: official GitHub source archive, verified object-for-object against the GitHub git data API because this machine has no git binary
sourceProvenance.note: commit/tree/blob SHAs match the official API; *.cmd blobs were restored from the archive's eol=crlf export form to canonical LF before hashing. The reconstructed .git has no index file; it exists for baseline identification, not for commits.
